items.title_zh: 智谱AI编程工具被曝将用户核心资产打包传走，但传了564次都失败！该产品用户达200多万，公司再回应：已正式开源，交由社区监督
items.title_en: Zhipu AI Coding Tool Allegedly Packaged User Data for Transfer, All 564 Attempts Failed
items.summary_zh: 智谱AI编程工具被曝将用户核心资产打包传走，但传了564次都失败！该产品用户达200多万，公司再回应：已正式开源，交由社区监督 mrjjxw.com
items.summary_en: Zhipu AI's coding tool was reported to have attempted to package and transmit users' core assets, with all 564 reported attempts failing. The product has more than 2 million users. Zhipu responded again, saying the tool has been officially open-sourced and placed under community oversight.
items.why_zh: 涉及数百万用户的AI编程工具数据安全争议，直接关系用户信任与开源透明度的价值。
items.why_en: A data-security dispute involving an AI coding tool with over 2 million users, testing user trust and the value of open-source transparency.

items.title_zh: 软银拟发行逾110亿美元高风险债券，为投资OpenAI融资
items.title_en: SoftBank to borrow over $11 billion in risky bonds for OpenAI stake
items.summary_zh: 据报道，软银计划通过发行超过110亿美元的高风险（垃圾级）债券来筹集资金，用于其对OpenAI的投资。此举意味着软银以较高融资成本加码AI领域布局，也放大了自身的财务杠杆与风险敞口。市场关注这笔规模可观的债务融资将如何影响软银的资产负债表及其在AI竞赛中的位置。
items.summary_en: SoftBank to borrow over $11 billion in risky bonds for OpenAI stake the-decoder.com
items.why_zh: 孙正义以高成本债务加码OpenAI，凸显AI竞赛的资本密集程度与软银的杠杆风险。
items.why_en: Masayoshi Son's high-cost debt bet on OpenAI highlights the capital intensity of the AI race and SoftBank's leverage risk.

items.title_zh: 智谱上线零数据留存机制
items.title_en: Zhipu AI Rolls Out Zero Data Retention Mechanism
items.summary_zh: 智谱上线零数据留存机制 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Zhipu AI has launched a zero data retention mechanism, meaning user data is not retained during service. The move is widely seen as a response to privacy and data-security concerns, coming amid scrutiny of its coding tool's data handling.
items.why_zh: 零数据留存是AI厂商回应隐私质疑的关键合规动作，直接影响用户对平台的信任。
items.why_en: Zero data retention is a key compliance step for AI vendors facing privacy scrutiny, directly shaping user trust.

items.title_zh: 比利时Aikido推出网络安全AI模型，本地化工具需求升温
items.title_en: Belgium's Aikido launches cybersecurity AI model as demand for local tools grows
items.summary_zh: 比利时公司Aikido发布了面向网络安全的AI模型，背景是市场对本土化安全工具的需求不断上升。该产品意在为企业和机构提供更贴近本地合规与数据主权要求的安全AI能力。随着欧洲对数据主权与本地化解决方案的关注增强，此类本土AI安全厂商正获得更多机会。
items.summary_en: Belgium's Aikido launches cybersecurity AI model as demand for local tools grows Reuters
items.why_zh: 反映欧洲对数据主权与本地AI安全工具的旺盛需求，本土厂商正迎来窗口期。
items.why_en: It reflects strong European demand for data sovereignty and locally built AI security tools, opening a window for domestic vendors.

items.title_zh: 智谱AI编程工具ZCode被曝偷传用户数据至境外，律师呼吁监管介入调查
items.title_en: Zhipu's ZCode Coding Tool Alleged to Send User Data Overseas, Lawyers Call for Regulatory Probe
items.summary_zh: 智谱AI编程工具ZCode被曝偷传用户数据至境外，律师呼吁监管介入调查 虎嗅
items.summary_en: Zhipu AI's ZCode coding tool has been accused of transferring user data overseas without users' knowledge, according to Huxiu. Lawyers are calling for regulators to investigate, citing cross-border data compliance and user rights concerns.
items.why_zh: 若属实将触及数据跨境合规红线，可能推动监管对AI开发工具数据处理的审查。
items.why_en: If substantiated, it would touch cross-border data compliance red lines and could prompt regulatory scrutiny of AI coding tools.

items.title_zh: Pabau Launches Agent Workforce: AI Employees for Medical Practices
items.title_en: Pabau Launches Agent Workforce: AI Employees for Medical Practices
items.summary_zh: Pabau Launches Agent Workforce: AI Employees for Medical Practices Business Wire
items.summary_en: Pabau has launched Agent Workforce, a set of "AI employees" designed for medical practices. The offering aims to have AI agents handle parts of clinics' daily operations and ease administrative and staffing burdens.
items.why_zh: 显示AI代理正加速进入医疗等垂直行业，承担实际运营职能。
items.why_en: It shows AI agents moving quickly into verticals like healthcare to take on real operational roles.

items.title_zh: 谷歌携五大 PC 厂商正式推出首批 Googlebook 笔记本，起售价 899 美元
items.title_en: Google and Five PC Makers Launch First Googlebook Laptops, Starting at $899
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，谷歌及其合作伙伴终于正式发布全新 Googlebook 产品线的首批笔记本电脑。首批一共五款机型，分别来自宏碁、华硕、戴尔、惠普以及联想。即日起开启预售，10 月 4 日正式上架销售。 产品起售价区间为 899 美元 （现汇率约合 6,028 元人民币） ‑1,299 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 8,709 元人民币） ，定价直接对标 MacBook Air 以及众多 Windows 轻薄本。每一台 Googlebook 均附赠 12 个月的 Google AI Pro 会员以及 5TB 云存储空间；另外还包含 YouTube Premium、Adobe Photoshop、剪映专业版（CapCut）三个月试用权益。谷歌承诺为本系列笔记本提供最长 10 年系统更新支持。 以下是各款 Googlebook 的硬件规格以及横向对比： 宏碁 Acer Googlebook 14 首发五款当中唯一一款可翻转二合一机型；设计思路近似 Acer Chromebook Plus Spin 714。官方标称续航最长 16 小时。它当前起售价最低：899 美元 （现汇率约合 6,028 元人民币） 。不过该价格属于限时首发价。宏碁的 Kelly Odle 在接受 The Verge 采访时表示，后续厂商会根据零部件供应状况以及市场压力重新评估定价，未来存在涨价可能…
items.summary_en: Google and five PC makers—Acer, Asus, Dell, HP, and Lenovo—officially launched the first Googlebook laptops, now on preorder and shipping October 4. Priced from $899 to $1,299, they target the MacBook Air and mainstream Windows ultrabooks, and each includes 12 months of Google AI Pro, 5TB of cloud storage, plus three-month trials of YouTube Premium, Adobe Photoshop, and CapCut, with up to 10 years of OS updates promised.
items.why_zh: 这是谷歌首次以统一品牌联合多家 PC 厂商推出笔记本，意在把 AI 订阅与长期系统支持打包进硬件，直接挑战 MacBook Air 与 Windows 轻薄本阵营。
items.why_en: It marks Google's first unified branded laptop line built with multiple PC makers, bundling AI subscriptions and decade-long OS support to challenge the MacBook Air and Windows ultrabooks.

items.title_zh: 冲刺 IPO，Nscale 的 1030 亿美元数据中心订单高度依赖微软和 Anthropic 两大客户
items.title_en: Nscale's $103 Billion Order Book Rests 85% on Microsoft and Anthropic Ahead of IPO
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，据彭博社报道，英国 AI 基础设施公司 Nscale 过去三年客户签约量激增千倍，主要归功于两家对人工智能算力如饥似渴的公司：微软和 Anthropic。 这两家公司贡献了该公司在首次公开募股（IPO）前夕披露的 1,030 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 6,905.85 亿元人民币） 合同总额中的 85%。不过，Nscale 尚未为 Anthropic 的合作项目落实融资。 这些细节凸显了伴随 AI 热潮兴起的新兴行业所面临的风险。Nscale 专门开发为 AI 服务定制化的数据中心，与“新云”（neocloud）厂商 CoreWeave 和 Nebius 展开竞争。 这些公司都是 AI 开发商与半导体企业这个“圈子”的一部分，彼此之间频繁进行行业内交易。这种循环式的交易往来被批评者视为潜在泡沫的信号。各家新云公司一直强调自身客户群的多元化，以此回击“过度依赖少数硅谷巨头”的质疑。 而 Nscale 的业务结构几乎没有多元化可言。该公司在上周五提交的 S-1 招股说明书中坦言：“我们的收入在很大程度上由少数几家客户贡献。” 除了依赖两大客户之外，这家英国公司还与英伟达深度绑定 —— 英伟达既是其主要股东，也是计划装配进 Nscale 数据中心的芯片的主要开发商。招股书列出了英伟达与 Nscale 之间的一系列交易：英伟达参与了多轮融资、供应芯片…
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that UK AI infrastructure firm Nscale's contract book has grown roughly a thousandfold in three years, with Microsoft and Anthropic accounting for 85% of the $103 billion in disclosed deals ahead of its IPO—and financing for the Anthropic project is not yet secured. The company, which builds AI-focused data centers and competes with neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius, admits in its S-1 filing that revenue depends heavily on a few customers, highlighting customer-concentration risk in the AI boom.
items.why_zh: 这家冲刺 IPO 的新云厂商几乎完全依赖两大客户并与英伟达深度绑定，是观察 AI 算力投资循环交易与潜在泡沫风险的典型案例。
items.why_en: An IPO-bound neocloud that depends on just two customers and is tightly tied to Nvidia is a prime case study of circular AI compute deals and bubble risk.

items.title_zh: 智谱MaaS平台上线数据不留存机制，ZCode完成整改
items.title_en: Zhipu's MaaS Platform Adds No-Data-Retention Mechanism as ZCode Completes Rectification
items.summary_zh: 智谱MaaS平台上线数据不留存机制，ZCode完成整改 3elife.net
items.summary_en: Zhipu's MaaS platform has rolled out a no-data-retention mechanism, and its ZCode product has completed rectification, according to 3elife.net. The report gives no further details on the mechanism's scope or the specific issues behind the rectification.
items.why_zh: 数据不留存机制关系到企业客户在调用大模型服务时的数据隐私与合规底线，也是国内 MaaS 平台竞争中的一项信任卖点。
items.why_en: A no-retention policy speaks directly to enterprise data privacy and compliance when calling LLM services, and is a trust selling point among Chinese MaaS platforms.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Pro或为2万亿参数：未来还有8万亿版、押注国产芯片
items.title_en: Rumor: DeepSeek V4.1 Pro May Hit 2 Trillion Parameters, With 8T Version and Domestic Chips Planned
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Pro或为2万亿参数：未来还有8万亿版、押注国产芯片 驱动之家
items.summary_en: Reports circulating via MyDrivers suggest DeepSeek's V4.1 Pro may have around 2 trillion parameters, with an 8-trillion-parameter version planned and a bet on domestic Chinese chips. No release timing, architecture, or chip partners were disclosed, so the claims remain unconfirmed.
items.why_zh: 若消息属实，国产大模型参数规模将再上台阶，并与国产芯片算力路线绑定，直接影响中美 AI 算力竞争格局。
items.why_en: If true, it would push domestic Chinese models to a new parameter scale tied to homegrown chips, shaping the US-China AI compute rivalry.

items.title_zh: 小米雷军澄清“打新宇树科技赚了 100 多亿”：是顺为投资的，而且不是打新、是早期天使投资
items.title_en: Lei Jun Clarifies Unitree Windfall: It Was Shunwei's Early Angel Investment, Not an IPO Subscription
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，小米创办人、董事长兼 CEO 雷军今日开启直播，和大家聊聊澎程发布这些天。 A 股人形机器人第一股宇树科技于 8 月 19 日上市 ，开盘大涨 629.44%，有网上传言“雷军打新宇树科技赚了 100 多亿”。 对此，雷军在今日的直播中澄清，不是他投资的， 而是顺为投资的 。第二也不是打新， 而是早期天使投资、早期风险投资 。 雷军表示，自己十几年前就认识了宇树科技创始人王兴兴，而且顺为是宇树科技 A 轮的唯一的投资者，当然顺为的股东们也赚了。 “顺为与小米为了构建生态链产业链，包括支持年轻人创业，有几个投资机构一直在推动整个硬核科技的创新。主要是我自己创业的时候就很难，找不到钱。所以 20 年前我就在国内开始鼓捣，大家要发展天使投资，让有想法的年轻人拿到第一笔投资，能够梦想成真。所以我们是基于这种想法，开始支持这些早期创业者的。” 综合IT之家此前报道，在今年 3 月的小米春季新品发布会前夕， 王兴兴带宇树最新机器人到场为新一代小米 SU7 站台 。雷军当时表示：“今年是（宇树科技）创业十周年。谢谢你在五年前给了我们一个投资（宇树）的机会”。 9 月 14 日， 雷军现身宇树科技公司 ，在王兴兴的陪同下实地探访并观看人形机器人表演，雷军还尝试踹了机器人一脚。
items.summary_en: After Unitree Robotics surged 629.44% on its August 19 listing, Lei Jun clarified in a livestream that the reported "10 billion yuan" gain was not his own but Shunwei Capital's, and came from early angel and venture investment rather than an IPO subscription. He said Shunwei was the sole investor in Unitree's Series A and that he has known founder Wang Xingxing for over a decade.
items.why_zh: 澄清厘清了个人与机构投资的边界，也让外界看到小米系资本在人形机器人赛道上的早期布局。
items.why_en: The clarification separates personal from institutional investing and highlights how Xiaomi-linked capital positioned itself early in the humanoid robotics race.

items.title_zh: 消息称理想汽车推进芯片子公司首轮融资，投前估值约 150 亿元
items.title_en: Report: Li Auto's Chip Subsidiary Seeks First External Round at About 15 Billion Yuan Pre-Money
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，据晚点 Auto 消息，理想芯片子公司正推进首轮外部融资，投前估值约 150 亿元，计划融资数十亿元。 工商信息显示，一家名为 Mach Intelligent Cores Limited（下称“Mach 香港”）的公司于 7 月 14 日在香港成立。8 月 4 日，Mach 香港全资持有的上海马赫智芯智能科技有限公司成立，理想 CTO 谢炎担任法定代表人。数日后，上海马赫智芯又全资设立上海马赫心科技有限公司，法定代表人为理想联席公司秘书王扬。 据悉，理想自研芯片团队约 200 人，主要从事 AI 算力架构、芯片设计和相关软件开发。目前，理想正同时推进车端、云端两类自研芯片项目。一位员工透露，理想人事部门已与芯片部门员工沟通调整劳动关系的事宜。 据IT之家此前报道， 理想马赫 M100 芯片发布于今年 6 月 ，采用 5nm 车规级工艺，单芯片算力 1280 TOPS。今年二季度以来，马赫 M100 芯片已在全新理想 L9、L8、L6、MEGA、i9 等车型上搭载上车。 相关阅读： 《 理想汽车总裁马东辉：马赫芯片、碳化硅模块可外供 》
items.summary_en: Li Auto's chip subsidiary is reportedly raising its first external round at a pre-money valuation of about 15 billion yuan, aiming for several billion yuan. The roughly 200-person team works on AI compute architecture, chip design, and software for both vehicle and cloud chips; its 5nm Mach M100 chip, rated at 1280 TOPS, has already shipped in several Li Auto models since Q2.
items.why_zh: 车企自研芯片从内部项目走向独立融资，意味着理想试图把智能驾驶与云端算力能力变成可对外输出的业务。
items.why_en: Spinning out chip development into a separately funded entity signals Li Auto's ambition to turn autonomous-driving and cloud compute capabilities into an external business.

items.title_zh: 美国在边境监控上花费数十亿，为何仍无法在人们死去前发现他们？
items.title_en: The US spent billions on border surveillance. Why can’t it catch people before they die?
items.summary_zh: 2024 年 4 月 8 日，32 岁生日前一天，José Morales Bernal 越过边境进入美国。当天早晨他徒步穿越新墨西哥州南部的沙漠时，正处于三座监控塔的探测范围内。这些由国防科技公司 Anduril 为美国海关与边境保护局（CBP）新建的监控塔配备摄像头和 AI，可自动侦测并追踪人员，还能将实时视频传回附近控制室，并向政府配发的智能手机发送警报。报道由此追问：在边境监控上投入数十亿美元、并引入 AI 侦测能力之后，系统为何仍未能在此类事件中及时发挥作用。
items.summary_en: When José Morales Bernal crossed the border into the United States on April 8, 2024, the day before his 32nd birthday, it should have triggered a chain of technological alerts and human responses. As he walked through the desert in southern New Mexico that morning, he was within range of three surveillance towers. Newly installed by US Customs and Border Protection (CBP), they were built by the defense tech company Anduril and equipped with cameras and AI to automatically detect and track people. They transmit live video to nearby control rooms and can send alerts to the government-issued smar…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了 AI 监控系统在真实生死场景中的失效环节，并引发对巨额边境监控投入实际效用的追问。
items.why_en: It exposes where AI surveillance fails in life-or-death situations and questions the real value of billions spent on border monitoring.

items.title_zh: 蚂蚁集团 CEO 韩歆毅发布全员信，将组建全新的支付宝事业群
items.title_en: Ant Group CEO Han Xinyi Announces New Alipay Business Group in All-Staff Letter
items.summary_zh: 9 月 21 日晚间消息，蚂蚁集团 CEO 韩歆毅发布全员信，宣布支付宝进行组织调整与人事任命，以加速布局智能体商业。 根据调整， 支付宝事业群、数字支付事业群和芝麻信用事业部将“会师”，组建全新的支付宝事业群 。吴敏芝将担任新支付宝事业群总裁，并兼任蚂蚁 CPO。 据悉，吴敏芝于 2021 年 8 月加入蚂蚁集团。在此之前在阿里巴巴集团任职 20 余年，先后担任阿里巴巴国际贸易事业群总裁、B2B 事业群总裁、阿里巴巴首席客户官等岗位，具有丰富的商业经验。 韩歆毅在信中表示，随着 AI 技术发展和行业渗透加速，智能体商业正迎来规模化爆发，而支付宝此前提出的“双飞轮”战略正是为迎接这一时刻。 据相关数据显示，个人生活助手阿宝上线三个月完成万余项服务的 AI 化升级，并和手机、车机、手表、眼镜等终端实现跨端互联。AI 支付完成全栈 AI 支付产品体系建设，并率先实现 3 亿笔 AI 支付。“碰一下”快速拓展线下支付份额，为商家开启数字化经营新入口。 此次组织调整的核心目标，是进一步聚拢技术、产品和生态能力，强化商家服务体系 —— 让每个用户拥有一个 AI 钱包和生活助手，让每个商家通过支付宝 AI 开放平台更好服务用户、实现生意增长，让支付宝的智能体商业生态在 AI 时代更加便捷、安全和可信。 原标题：《蚂蚁集团 CEO 韩歆毅发布全员信，宣布组织调整和全新任命》
items.summary_en: Ant Group CEO Han Xinyi announced an organizational shake-up merging Alipay's business group, digital payment group, and Sesame Credit unit into a single new Alipay business group, with Wu Minzhi as president and concurrent Ant CPO. The move aims to accelerate agentic commerce, citing AI upgrades to over 10,000 services via the A Bao assistant in three months and 300 million AI-powered payments.
items.why_zh: 这是蚂蚁在智能体商业爆发前夜的一次关键组织收拢，把支付、生活服务与信用能力整合到统一事业群，直接影响国内 AI 支付与生态竞争格局。
items.why_en: It is a key organizational consolidation ahead of an agentic commerce boom, uniting payments, lifestyle services, and credit under one group and shaping China's AI payment competition.

items.title_zh: 软银启动110亿美元垃圾债券发行，为投资OpenAI筹资
items.title_en: SoftBank launches $11 billion junk bond deal for OpenAI bet
items.summary_zh: 软银启动总额110亿美元的垃圾债券（高收益债）发行，所筹资金用于支持其对OpenAI的投资。这是近年来规模最大的高收益债券交易之一，反映出软银正通过大规模举债加码人工智能领域布局。该交易也凸显出AI投资热潮下，资本对算力与大模型公司的追逐，以及软银由此承担的更高融资成本与信用风险。
items.summary_en: SoftBank launches $11 billion junk bond deal for OpenAI bet qz.com
items.why_zh: 这是近年规模最大的高收益债券交易之一，显示软银正以高杠杆押注OpenAI与AI赛道。
items.why_en: It ranks among the largest junk bond deals in years, underscoring SoftBank's highly leveraged bet on OpenAI and AI.

items.title_zh: “偷传代码”风波后，智谱把ZCode开源了：三天， 三步
items.title_en: After code-leak controversy, Zhipu open-sources ZCode in three days and three steps
items.summary_zh: “偷传代码”风波后，智谱把ZCode开源了：三天， 三步 huxiu.com
items.summary_en: Following allegations that its ZCode tool secretly uploaded user code, Zhipu has open-sourced ZCode, reportedly completing the process in three days and three steps. The move is seen as an effort to improve transparency and rebuild developer trust after a security overhaul.
items.why_zh: 知名大模型公司因数据安全质疑而被迫开源，反映出开发者对隐私与信任的敏感度上升。
items.why_en: A major LLM company open-sourcing under data-safety pressure highlights growing developer sensitivity to privacy and trust.

items.title_zh: “偷传数据”引争议后，智谱上线“零数据留存”机制

items.summary_zh: “偷传数据”引争议后，智谱上线“零数据留存”机制 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Following a controversy over alleged unauthorized data transmission, Zhipu has introduced a zero data retention mechanism. It is part of a broader security overhaul aimed at addressing user and developer privacy concerns.
items.why_zh: 头部厂商以“零数据留存”回应隐私争议，可能推动行业形成更明确的数据合规标准。
items.why_en: A leading AI vendor adopting zero data retention could push the industry toward clearer data compliance norms.

items.summary_en: SoftBank Launches $11 Billion Bond Sale To Finance OpenAI Investment Pulse 2.0
items.why_zh: 以巨额举债押注OpenAI，凸显AI投资竞赛中资本规模与风险的同步放大。
items.why_en: Funding an OpenAI bet with massive debt shows how both capital and risk are scaling up in the AI race.

items.summary_en: Zhipu has reportedly secured about 1 billion yuan in orders, yet Chinese cybersecurity stocks keep sliding. The article examines this mismatch between order wins and market performance, suggesting investors remain wary about the sector's outlook.
items.why_zh: 订单落地与股价背离，揭示市场对网安行业盈利模式和估值仍缺乏信心。
items.why_en: The gap between order wins and falling share prices reveals lingering doubts about the cybersecurity sector's earnings and valuation.

items.title_zh: 消息称三星组建新团队研发芯片工厂机器人，推进半导体工厂自动化转型
items.title_en: Samsung Forms New 'AX / PI' Team to Build Robots for Chip Fabs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，三星正把自身的机器人战略进一步延伸至半导体业务板块。该公司专门组建了一支团队，为其芯片工厂研发机器人，以此落实工厂向人工智能驱动的自主化生产基地转型的规划。 据《韩国中央日报》的报道，三星近期在设备解决方案事业部（DS）下属的全球制造与基础设施技术部门之下，新成立了名为“AX / PI”的专项团队，负责芯片工厂自动化机器人的研发与落地部署。 据悉这支新团队的不少人员来自三星原有设备技术研究院；该研究院此前主要从事设备开发、零部件本土化以及自动化相关工作。三星初期打算把机器人投入设备维护场景，借此替代外包人员以及现场工程师承担的一部分重复性作业。 该项目目前仍处在早期阶段。三星现阶段一边收集现场数据，一边规划机器人的行进路线、作业区域以及零部件存放点位。在正式向半导体厂房投入机器人之前，三星需要先完成上述各项内容的标准化工作。 一位业内人士表示，半导体晶圆厂本身十分适合推进自动化：厂区设备位置固定、行进路线预先划定、作业环境可控。正因如此，三星在这类工厂当中实现作业自动化的难度相对更低。 例如泛林集团（Lam Research）已于 2024 年推出 Dextro 协作机器人，专门用于半导体设备维护。这款机器人可以完成耗材安装、紧固、清洁等重复性工作。 IT之家注意到，三星另外还有 RX 业务办公室，主要负责通用型人形机器人业务。该办公室设立于设备体验…
items.summary_en: Samsung has set up a dedicated 'AX / PI' team under its DS division's global manufacturing and infrastructure technology unit to develop robots for its chip fabs, part of a push toward AI-driven autonomous manufacturing. The team, drawing staff from Samsung's equipment technology institute, will initially deploy robots in equipment maintenance to replace some repetitive work done by contractors and on-site engineers. The project is still early-stage, with Samsung collecting site data and standardizing robot routes and work zones.
items.why_zh: 半导体工厂流程固定、环境可控，是机器人自动化最容易率先落地的场景之一，三星此举显示其正把 AI 制造能力从通用机器人延伸到核心芯片业务。
items.why_en: Chip fabs, with fixed equipment and controlled environments, are among the most automation-ready settings, so Samsung's move signals it is extending AI manufacturing from general-purpose robots into its core semiconductor business.

items.title_en: Zhipu Accused of Uploading User Data Without Consent, Then Apologizes and Open-Sources ZCode
items.summary_zh: 智谱被指未经用户允许上传数据 随后致歉并开源ZCode 财新

items.why_en: Allegations of uploading user data without consent go to the heart of AI data compliance and user trust, prompting the company to respond with an apology and an open-source release.

items.summary_en: SoftBank Lines Up A $10 Billion Bond Sale For OpenAI Finimize

items.title_zh: 联合国：不必等风险完全厘清，各国应提前管控 AI 智能体
items.title_en: UN Expert Panel: Governments Should Regulate AI Agents Before Risks Are Fully Understood
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，联合国一个科学专家小组发布警示： 各国政府应当在完全厘清风险之前，就对能力日益强大的 AI 智能体加以管控 。这份报告也是该国际组织针对今年早些时候 OpenAI 入侵 Hugging Face 一事出具的首份重要评估文件。 IT之家注意到，本周各国领导人齐聚纽约出席联合国大会，中美双方也同步开展人工智能相关会谈；这份报告的发布，进一步将人工智能议题推上全球外交议程。上周，联合国秘书长安东尼奥 · 古特雷斯（António Guterres）呼吁各国政府开展合作，共同应对人工智能带来的威胁。他同时发出警告：“世界承受不起一场在 AI 安全层面竞相降低标准的恶性竞赛。” 这份文件是联合国人工智能独立国际科学专家小组发布的首份专题简报。该专家小组成立于去年，是联合国旗下“首个人工智能领域全球性科学机构”。简报提出：即便各个国家选择不同的立法监管路径，全球仍然需要投入更多关注与资源，管控高级人工智能正在浮现的各类风险；同时还要强化国际层面在安全与追责方面的协作。 报告当中尤为关键的一点是，该专家小组提出，世界不必等到科研人员彻底厘清此类事故发生的机理与成因之后，再去落实更强的防护措施。专家小组认为，失控风险恰恰正是预防原则所要应对的问题：“即潜在损害有可能是灾难性、不可逆的，但该风险发生的概率在科学层面尚且无法确定。” 预防原则最早写入 1992 年《联合…
items.summary_en: A UN scientific expert panel warned that governments should regulate increasingly capable AI agents before risks are fully understood, in the first thematic brief from the UN's Independent International Scientific Panel on AI and its first major assessment tied to this year's OpenAI–Hugging Face incident. The panel said the world cannot wait for researchers to fully explain how such failures occur before adopting stronger safeguards, invoking the precautionary principle for potentially catastrophic, irreversible risks whose likelihood remains scientifically uncertain.
items.why_zh: 这是联合国首次以全球科学机构名义就 AI 智能体风险发声，并主张在因果关系未明前即采取预防性监管，可能影响各国 AI 立法节奏与国际协作框架。
items.why_en: It is the UN's first scientific-body call to act on AI agent risks before causation is clear, and could shape the pace of national AI legislation and international cooperation.

items.why_en: An $11 billion bond sale to fund a single AI investment reflects SoftBank's aggressive capital commitment to AI and its reliance on debt financing.

items.title_zh: 华为发布 Fintelligent AI 方案，助全球金融机构实现“Own Your AI, Own Your Intelligence”
items.title_en: Huawei Launches Fintelligent AI Solution to Help Global Financial Institutions Realize "Own Your AI, Own Your Intelligence"
items.summary_zh: 华为发布面向金融行业的 Fintelligent AI 解决方案，帮助全球金融机构实现其提出的“Own Your AI, Own Your Intelligence”（自主掌控 AI 与智能）目标。该方案定位为金融机构的 AI 落地工具，强调机构对自身 AI 能力与智能资产的主导权。现有信息未披露方案的具体技术架构、客户案例或可用时间表。
items.summary_en: Huawei Launches Fintelligent AI Solution to Help Global Financial Institutions Realize "Own Your AI, Own Your Intelligence" PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 华为借“自主可控 AI”切入金融行业，呼应金融机构对数据主权与合规的诉求，也是其行业 AI 方案版图的扩张。
items.why_en: Huawei is entering financial services with a self-controlled AI pitch that matches banks' data-sovereignty and compliance demands, expanding its industry AI portfolio.

items.summary_zh: 华为发布 AI Practice LAB（AIPL）解决方案，称其为“教育 + AI”人才培养树立新范式。该方案面向教育场景，意在支持 AI 相关教学与实践训练的结合。现有信息未披露方案的具体构成、合作院校或落地规模。
items.summary_en: Huawei Launches the AI Practice LAB (AIPL) Solution, Setting a New Paradigm for "Education + AI" Talent Cultivation PR Newswire
items.why_zh: AI 人才短缺是全球性瓶颈，华为以实验室方案切入教育市场，既是人才培养布局，也是其 AI 生态向院校延伸的一步。
items.why_en: With AI talent scarce globally, Huawei's lab-style offering is both a talent-cultivation play and an extension of its AI ecosystem into schools and universities.

items.title_zh: 华为云码道上线鸿蒙编码大模型，千行代码错误率降低 80% 以上
items.title_en: Huawei Cloud CodeArts Launches HarmonyOS Coding Model, Cutting Errors per 1,000 Lines by Over 80%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，华为云今日（9 月 21 日）宣布，华为云码道 CodeArts 代码智能体面向鸿蒙开发者进行全面升级，上线“鸿蒙编码大模型 + 码道鸿蒙智能体 + 鸿蒙开发者实践中心”三大核心能力， 打造全球首个且唯一专为鸿蒙生态打造的 AI 编码智能体 。 IT之家附本次升级内容如下： 鸿蒙编码大模型 依托华为云独有的鸿蒙增强训练体系，鸿蒙编码大模型融合超百万鸿蒙原素材，深度学习优秀鸿蒙项目代码库与组件资产（含开源样例、鸿蒙 API、开发规范及 UI / UX 布局模板），实现与 ArkTS 语言及鸿蒙开发范式的深度适配： 训练数据“更全”： 10 万 + 鸿蒙高质量数据，高频鸿蒙开发场景组件 100% 覆盖，囊括鸿蒙 API、开发规范、代码库及组件资产； 代码生成“更准”： 千行代码错误率降低 80% 以上，从根本上减少开发者调试负担； 编译通过“更稳”： 一次编译通过率提升 78% 以上； Token 消耗“更省”： 单次任务 Token 消耗降低 20% 以上。 鸿蒙编码智能体 鸿蒙编码智能体能一站式覆盖从需求梳理、方案设计、代码编写、到编译构建全流程，减少开发者反复介入，实现鸿蒙应用端到端开发。 同时智能体中内置了 DevEco CLI， 可以直接调用鸿蒙端侧模拟器 ，让开发结果即时可见、可调，这个属于业界首创的能力。可实现鸿蒙应用天然适配各类手机、平板…
items.summary_en: Huawei Cloud announced a major upgrade to its CodeArts coding agent for HarmonyOS developers, introducing a HarmonyOS coding model, a coding agent, and a developer practice center. The company says the model cuts errors per 1,000 lines of code by over 80% and lifts first-time compile success rates by more than 78%. The agent covers the full workflow from requirements to build, with a built-in DevEco CLI that can call on-device HarmonyOS emulators.
items.why_zh: 这是云厂商围绕单一操作系统生态构建专用 AI 编码能力的标志性动作，可能加速鸿蒙原生应用供给。
items.why_en: It marks a cloud vendor building AI coding capability around a single OS ecosystem, potentially accelerating native HarmonyOS app development.

items.why_zh: 企业公开整改加开源的做法，成为AI工具隐私争议中的一种信任修复范式。
items.why_en: Public remediation plus open-sourcing offers a trust-rebuilding template for AI tool privacy disputes.

items.summary_en: SoftBank launches one of biggest junk bond deals to fund OpenAI bet Financial Times

items.why_en: Extending AI coding assistants to the desktop is a key step for model makers competing for the developer entry point.

items.title_zh: 国内大模型出海加速：Kimi K3上线亚马逊云，与海外云厂商分成模式落地
items.title_en: Kimi K3 Lands on AWS as Chinese LLMs Push Overseas With Revenue-Sharing Deals
items.summary_zh: 国内大模型出海加速：Kimi K3上线亚马逊云，与海外云厂商分成模式落地 t.cj.sina.cn
items.summary_en: Moonshot's Kimi K3 model has been made available on Amazon Web Services, part of a broader push by Chinese large-model developers into overseas markets. The move also involves a revenue-sharing arrangement with an overseas cloud provider, offering a potentially replicable commercialization path for other Chinese AI firms.
items.why_zh: 与海外云厂商分成上架，是国产大模型出海从“自建渠道”转向“借船出海”的关键商业化尝试。
items.why_en: Revenue-sharing distribution via an overseas cloud provider marks a shift from self-built channels to platform-based overseas commercialization for Chinese LLMs.

items.title_zh: 国内大模型出海加速：Kimi K3上线亚马逊云，与海外云厂商分成模式落地
items.title_en: Chinese LLMs go global: Kimi K3 lands on AWS with revenue-sharing model
items.summary_zh: 国内大模型出海加速：Kimi K3上线亚马逊云，与海外云厂商分成模式落地 thepaper.cn
items.summary_en: Kimi K3 has gone live on Amazon Web Services, with a revenue-sharing arrangement between the model maker and the overseas cloud provider. The move marks faster overseas expansion for Chinese LLMs and a new commercialization path through global cloud channels.
items.why_zh: 国产大模型借海外云平台分销并分成，为中国AI商业化与全球化提供新范式。
items.why_en: Chinese LLMs distributing through overseas clouds with revenue sharing offers a new template for AI globalization and monetization.

items.title_zh: 双信源互相佐证，英伟达 GeForce RTX 60 系列游戏显卡很可能 2028 年发布
items.title_en: Two Leakers Point to a 2028 Launch for Nvidia's GeForce RTX 60 Series
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，消息人士 @kopite7kimi 北京时间今日表示，英伟达下代游戏显卡的基石 —— "GR20x" 系列 GPU 是 2028 年的产品，这意味着 GeForce RTX 60 系列显卡遭遇推迟 。 另一位消息人士 @Kepler_L2 本月早些时候曾表示 NVIDIA（英伟达）不会在 2027 年推出新一代游戏显卡；AMD 也将仅在明年推出 "RDNA 5" 微架构的 "AT2" 芯片，其它 "RDNA 5" 产品留待 2028 年发布。 与此同时，英特尔自 "Xe²" 后的游戏独立显卡产品目前处于“生死不明”的状态。 相关阅读： 《 消息称英伟达 2027 下半年推出 RTX 60 系列显卡，Rubin 架构 》
items.summary_en: Two well-known hardware leakers suggest Nvidia's next-generation gaming GPUs, the "GR20x" family underpinning GeForce RTX 60, are 2028 products, implying a delay for the RTX 60 series. Another leaker earlier said Nvidia would not launch a new gaming GPU in 2027, while AMD's remaining RDNA 5 parts are also said to slip to 2028.
items.why_zh: 若消息属实，游戏显卡的换代周期将被进一步拉长，玩家与整机厂商需按更长的空窗期规划。
items.why_en: If accurate, it means a longer gap between gaming GPU generations, affecting upgrade plans for consumers and PC makers alike.

items.title_zh: 新增北京大连：苹果 AirPods 5 主动降噪耳机 849 元国补限地区，以旧换新 699 元起
items.title_en: Apple's AirPods 5 Arrive With Active Noise Cancellation, Subsidized Prices From 849 Yuan
items.summary_zh: 苹果今日宣布推出 AirPods 5 ，支持主动降噪，国行定价 999 元起。 京东目前支持部分地区政府补贴（收货地址在 江苏、吉林、北京、大连 ），实付 849.15 元起。 另外京东今日加码“以旧换新”，旧物估值超过 100 元（限耳机品类），京东加补 100~150 元，新耳机折合仅需 699~749 元好价： 京东 Apple AirPods 5 支持主动降噪 国补后 849 元 直达链接 京东 Apple AirPods 5 搭配无线充电盒 增强续航 国补后 977 元 直达链接 京东“换新补贴”由系统自动发放，如果点击上方卡片没有弹出，可尝试 反复点击上方卡片 / 换号下单哦。 AirPods 5 采用全新多孔声学架构，具备新一代自适应均衡功能，打造更具沉浸感的音效。突破性的无耳塞式主动降噪功能， 消除外部噪音效果相较 AirPods 4（支持主动降噪）提升最高 50% ，通透模式也更为自然。用户还可使用头部动作回应 Siri。 专为 AirPods 5 重新打造的全新多孔声学架构和新一代自适应均衡功能，灵感源自 AirPods Pro 3，适用于更多耳形，可呈现更丰富细腻的音质。 对于有更高需求的用户，配备无线充电盒的 AirPods 5 进一步大幅提升了 AirPods 体验。 AirPods 5 首次为无耳塞式耳机配备了支持音量轻扫功能的力度感应器 ，用户可上下轻…
items.summary_en: Apple unveiled AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation, priced from 999 yuan in China, with government subsidies in select regions bringing the price to 849.15 yuan and trade-in deals as low as 699 yuan on JD.com. Apple says the open-fit ANC cuts external noise up to 50% more than AirPods 4 with ANC, and the model adds a force sensor for volume swipes.
items.why_zh: 新品叠加地方补贴与以旧换新，折射出消费电子在促销政策驱动下的定价竞争。
items.why_en: New hardware combined with local subsidies and trade-in incentives highlights how policy-driven promotions are shaping consumer electronics pricing.

items.title_zh: Peec AI 推出 Brand Perception，展示 AI 模型如何描述与比较品牌
items.title_en: Peec AI Launches Brand Perception to Show Companies How AI Models Describe, Compare, and Characterize Their Brands
items.summary_zh: 据 AiThority 报道，Peec AI 推出名为 Brand Perception 的新产品，用于向企业展示 AI 模型如何描述、比较和刻画其品牌。该产品的定位是帮助企业了解自身在 AI 生成内容与回答中呈现出的形象，从而掌握品牌在 AI 渠道中的实际表达。随着越来越多用户通过对话式 AI 获取信息与选购建议，品牌在模型输出中的呈现方式正成为新的关注点，但报道未披露具体功能细节、定价或可用时间。
items.summary_en: Peec AI Launches Brand Perception to Show Companies How AI Models Describe, Compare, and Characterize Their Brands AiThority
items.why_zh: 它把“品牌在 AI 回答里被怎么说”变成可观测指标，回应了 AI 搜索与推荐兴起后的品牌监测新需求。
items.why_en: It turns how brands are portrayed in AI answers into a measurable signal, addressing a new monitoring need as AI search and recommendations spread.

items.title_zh: 亚马逊投资的 Anthropic 被曝考虑在 IPO 前发布新 AI 模型
items.title_en: Amazon-Backed Anthropic Mulls Launch of New AI Model Ahead of IPO
items.summary_zh: 据 marketscreener.com 消息，亚马逊投资的 AI 公司 Anthropic 正考虑在其 IPO 之前推出新的 AI 模型。报道未披露该模型的具体名称、能力参数与发布时间表，也未说明 IPO 的规模与时间安排。作为 Claude 系列模型的开发方，Anthropic 的模型迭代与上市节奏历来受市场关注，此番“新品先于上市”的传闻进一步强化了外界对其资本动作与产品节奏的联想。
items.summary_en: Amazon-Backed Anthropic Mulls Launch of New AI Model Ahead of IPO marketscreener.com
items.why_zh: 头部大模型公司在 IPO 窗口前的模型发布节奏，往往被视为其估值与商业化叙事的重要铺垫。
items.why_en: For a leading AI lab, a model launch before an IPO is often seen as groundwork for its valuation and commercialization story.

items.title_zh: 智谱就ZCode数据上传争议第三次回应：完成整改并开源代码
items.title_en: Zhipu Responds a Third Time to ZCode Data-Upload Controversy, Says Fix Done and Code Open-Sourced
items.summary_zh: 智谱就ZCode数据上传争议第三次回应：完成整改并开源代码 虎嗅
items.summary_en: Zhipu issued a third response to the controversy over data uploading in its ZCode tool, saying it has completed rectifications and open-sourced the code. The company has addressed the issue publicly multiple times, with this reply emphasizing fixes and code transparency, though specifics were not detailed.
items.why_zh: 开发者工具的数据上传与隐私问题正成为国内 AI 产品信任度的敏感点，开源被视为重建信任的手段。
items.why_en: Data-upload and privacy issues in developer tools are a sensitive trust point for Chinese AI products, and open-sourcing is being used to rebuild confidence.

items.summary_en: Moonshot AI's Kimi Code Desktop coding tool is now officially available for both macOS and Windows. The desktop client extends the company's AI coding efforts to local developer environments, though feature and pricing details were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 桌面端编程工具是 AI 编程入口争夺的关键一环，月之暗面借此与同类产品正面竞争。
items.why_en: Desktop coding tools are a key battleground for AI coding entry points, putting Moonshot in direct competition with rival offerings.

items.title_zh: AI 帮银行省钱：法国兴业银行预计最多可省下 6 亿欧元成本
items.title_en: AI helps banks cut costs: Societe Generale expects up to €600 million in savings
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，据彭博社报道，法国兴业银行（Societe Generale SA）预测，人工智能应用范围不断扩大，将为该行的降本工作带来可观贡献。 这家总部位于巴黎的银行表示，借助人工智能实现降本的当前潜在空间介于 5 亿至 6 亿欧元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 38.47 亿至 46.16 亿元人民币） 之间。其中，到 2029 年为止已经落实规划的降本规模约为 3.5 亿欧元 （现汇率约合 26.93 亿元人民币） 。 法国兴业银行称，该行将得益于与美国 AI 巨头 Anthropic 开展的战略合作，合作内容包括持续分批部署后者的 Claude 大模型。 不少银行都表态，人工智能将在提升运营效率方面发挥越来越重要的作用；少数机构甚至已经据此预判了对就业岗位带来的影响。摩根士丹利分析师今年早些时候估算，受 AI 因素影响， 欧洲银行业的员工规模最高可能缩减五分之一。 法国兴业银行认为 AI 可以在多个业务领域释放潜力： 自动生成报告、关键绩效指标监控、削减代码开发成本，以及扩充面向客户的咨询服务能力。 本次相关表态是法国兴业银行首席执行官斯拉沃米尔 · 克鲁帕（Slawomir Krupa）为提升盈利能力所作承诺的一部分。克鲁帕还于周一公布了新一轮削减成本计划；部分降本举措预计将通过裁员完成，但他并未披露具体的裁员规模。
items.summary_en: Societe Generale says AI could cut its costs by €500–600 million, with about €350 million of that already planned through 2029. The Paris-based bank credits a strategic partnership with Anthropic that includes phased deployment of its Claude models, and sees AI potential in automated reporting, KPI monitoring, lower code-development costs and expanded client advisory services. The move is part of CEO Slawomir Krupa's profitability push, alongside a new cost-cutting plan that will partly rely on job cuts of undisclosed scale.
items.why_zh: 这是大型银行公开量化 AI 降本潜力的最新案例，也显示 AI 正与裁员计划一道被用于重塑银行业的成本结构。
items.why_en: It is one of the clearest public estimates by a major bank of how much AI can cut costs, showing how AI is being folded into broader banking cost restructuring, including layoffs.

items.title_zh: vivo X500 Pro 手机部分规格公布：天玑 9600 Pro、全球首发蔡司超动态主摄，今晚发布
items.title_en: vivo X500 Pro specs teased: Dimensity 9600 Pro and world-first Zeiss ultra-dynamic main camera ahead of tonight's launch
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，vivo X500 系列手机将于今晚 19 点发布，vivo 通信科技有限公司产品经理韩伯啸今日公布 Pro 版新机部分规格。 据其介绍，vivo X500 Pro“可能是 72 毫米以内最好的手机”。影像方面， 新机全球首发蔡司超动态主摄 ，蓝图光御 900 传感器，实际输出 17EV 超高动态范围，支持单帧 TCG，索尼手机传感器目前最高序列定位，历史最低读出噪声。全球首发蔡司 APO 85mm 超级长焦，蓝图 × 索尼 LYTIA 610，支持「口红 200」。 此外，他还表示， 新机搭载满血 2nm 蓝晶 × 天玑 9600 Pro 处理器 ，不仅仅 CPU 架构最新，GPU NPU 都是满血版本，图像和 AI 处理能力一样巅峰，而非常“冷静”。机身薄至 7.95mm，6.36 英寸超窄四等边，目前京东方最好的 Q11 基材。 IT之家注意到，官方此前透露 vivo X500 Pro Max 全球首发京东方 Q11 2K 蔡司大师色彩屏 —— 一块 6.85 英寸 2K 的 Pro Max 大屏，首发 2nm 天玑 9600 Pro 处理器。新机搭载蔡司 2 亿 APO 超级长焦，传感器为 X300 Ultra 同款，1/1.4" 蓝图 × 三星 HP0。全球首发蓝图光御 900 传感器，还首发主摄和潜望长焦 CIPA 7.0 防抖等级，带来…
items.summary_en: vivo is set to launch its X500 series tonight, and a company product manager has detailed some Pro model specs: a world-first Zeiss ultra-dynamic main camera with the Lantai Guangyu 900 sensor, a world-first Zeiss APO 85mm telephoto, and a full-spec 2nm Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset. The phone is 7.95mm thin with a 6.36-inch narrow-bezel display using BOE's Q11 substrate. The Pro Max is also confirmed to debut a BOE Q11 2K Zeiss display and a 200MP Zeiss APO telephoto.
items.why_zh: 新机集中首发多项影像传感器与 2nm 芯片规格，反映出高端手机在影像和先进制程芯片上的竞争进一步提速。
items.why_en: The launch packs multiple world-first camera and 2nm chip claims, underscoring how fierce the high-end smartphone race has become around imaging and cutting-edge silicon.

items.title_en: Moonshot AI releases Kimi Code Desktop client
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi Code Desktop桌面客户端 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has released a desktop client called Kimi Code Desktop, apparently aimed at coding workflows. Beyond the product's release, details such as features, supported platforms, pricing and availability have not been disclosed. The move signals Moonshot's continued push into developer tooling built on its Kimi models.
items.why_zh: 这意味着月之暗面正把 Kimi 的能力延伸到面向开发者的桌面编程工具，加码编程助手这一竞争激烈的方向。
items.why_en: It shows Moonshot AI extending Kimi beyond chat into desktop coding tools, deepening its bet on the competitive AI programming-assistant market.

items.title_zh: 智谱回应ZCode争议：“开源”“不留存”
items.title_en: Zhipu Responds to ZCode Controversy, Stressing 'Open Source' and 'No Retention'

items.summary_en: Zhipu has responded to the controversy surrounding its ZCode offering, emphasizing that it is 'open source' and that data is 'not retained.' The statement appears aimed at addressing external concerns over transparency and user data handling. Further details on the dispute and follow-up remain limited.
items.why_zh: 开源与数据不留存是 AI 编程工具最受关注的合规与信任问题，厂商的公开表态直接影响开发者与企业的采用意愿。
items.why_en: Open-source status and data retention are key compliance and trust issues for AI coding tools, and a vendor's public stance directly affects developer and enterprise adoption.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布 Kimi Code Desktop 桌面客户端，macOS 和 Windows 版同步上线
items.title_en: Moonshot AI Launches Kimi Code Desktop for macOS and Windows
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，今天月之暗面 Kimi 发布了 Kimi Code Desktop，macOS 和 Windows 版同步上线，可访问 kimi.com/ code 安装使用。 作为 Kimi Code 官方桌面客户端，它将 Kimi Code 智能编程服务能力带到桌面应用中。用户不仅可以在桌面端内直接使用 Kimi Code 的 AI Agent 能力，通过对话让它读写代码、运行命令、完成自动化任务，还能在全新可视化的图形交互界面中，集中管理所有项目，调整常用配置，清晰查看 Agent 执行任务的每一步。 针对开发者的实际工作流，桌面端还提供内置终端、浏览器和 Git 状态查看等功能，支持直接运行和调试项目、审阅代码改动，关联 PR 状态，方便跟踪代码评审与合并进度。 IT之家附官方详细介绍如下： 如何安装和使用？ 第一步：下载并安装 Kimi Code Desktop 下载地址： kimi.com/ code，目前已支持 macOS（Apple + Intel 芯片）、Windows。 第二步：一键登录 Kimi Code 账号，或配置第三方模型供应商 作为 Kimi Coding Plan 的官方搭配 Agent，更推荐在 Kimi Code Desktop 直接登录使用，套餐用量随时可查。登录 Kimi 账号后，桌面端会使用账号可用的官方模型。你可以在输入框…
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI released Kimi Code Desktop for macOS and Windows, bringing its AI coding agent into a native app with a visual interface. The client adds a built-in terminal, browser and Git status view, and supports either Kimi Code login or third-party model providers.
items.why_zh: 桌面端补齐终端、Git 与 PR 视图，把 AI 编程 Agent 变成完整的本地开发环境。
items.why_en: By bundling a terminal, Git and PR views, the desktop client turns the AI coding agent into a full local development environment.

items.title_zh: 消息称软银拟发超 110 亿美元高收益债，加码 OpenAI 投资
items.title_en: SoftBank Plans Over $11 Billion High-Yield Bond Sale to Fund OpenAI Bet
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，据彭博社报道，知情人士周一透露，随着孙正义旗下的软银集团不断加大对 OpenAI 的投资力度， 该集团正计划筹措超过 110 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 737.52 亿元人民币） 等值资金 ，这有望成为有史以来规模最大的高收益债（垃圾债）发行交易之一。 知情人士称，软银计划发行分为三种期限、总值 100 亿美元 （现汇率约合 670.47 亿元人民币） 的美元债券，以及分为两种期限、总值 10 亿欧元 （现汇率约合 76.93 亿元人民币） 的欧元票据。 所筹资金将有部分用于预计将于下月完成的对 OpenAI 的追加投资。知情人士补充称，该笔交易可能会在周四确定发行定价。 今年 3 月，软银曾签署一笔 400 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,681.88 亿元人民币） 的过桥贷款以支持对 OpenAI 的新一轮注资，并在近期结清了该授信项下 259 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,736.52 亿元人民币） 的未偿余额。为了持续扩大其在人工智能领域的融资能力，软银频频出击，在债券市场上展开了一系列密集的发债融资。 截至上周，软银储备的潜在新增借款已近 210 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,407.99 亿元人民币） 。知情人士上周五透露，该集团已将其芯片子公司安谋控股的股票质押贷款规模增加了 50 亿美元 （现汇率约合 335.24 亿元人民币） ，总额提升…
items.summary_en: SoftBank is reportedly planning to raise more than $11 billion through high-yield bonds, including $10 billion of dollar notes and €1 billion of euro notes, partly to fund an additional investment in OpenAI expected next month.
items.why_zh: 巨额债务融资显示软银正以高杠杆押注 OpenAI，也反映 AI 投入对资本的空前需求。
items.why_en: The huge debt raise shows SoftBank's highly leveraged bet on OpenAI and the unprecedented capital demands of AI investment.

items.title_zh: 小鹏合作新车，大众安徽与众 09 亮相发布会定档 9 月 24 日
items.title_en: Volkswagen Anhui's Yuzhong 09 to Debut on September 24, Second Joint Model with XPeng
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，大众安徽今日官宣，与众 09 量产启动暨亮相发布会将于 9 月 24 日举行。 IT之家注意到，该车是大众和 小鹏汽车 在 24 个月内联合开发的第二款车型。据官方介绍，它采用专属“狼系美学”设计，打破传统轿车的平淡造型。水晶切割灯组与智能科技光带相呼应，加上独特的狼头徽标和专属金标 Logo，延伸式长引擎盖拉满气场；侧身线条凌厉极具狩猎质感，一眼区别于同级车型。 该车车长超 5 米， 轴距达 3030mm 。此外，这款新车搭载大众人本科技“行云智行”和“云栖智舱”等先进技术，包括 VLA 大模型全场景智能辅助驾驶、AI 智能助手、超强算力，官方宣称“智能化水平跻身第一梯队”。 这款新车已经出现在工信部 7 月《道路机动车辆生产企业及产品公告》 中。本次申报共有两款版本，分别为单电机后驱版以及双电机四驱版，均采用磷酸铁锂蓄电池，由宁德时代提供电芯，大众汽车（安徽）零部件有限公司负责生产电池总成。 双电机四驱版整备质量 2307 kg，总质量 2760 kg，轴距 3030 mm，车身尺寸为长 5081 mm / 宽 1980 mm / 高 1509 mm，轮胎规格为 255/45R21，最高车速 200 km/h。驱动方面，前电机额定功率 50 kW，峰值功率 140 kW；后电机额定功率 110 kW，峰值功率 230 kW。 单电机后驱版整备质量…
items.summary_en: Volkswagen Anhui will unveil the Yuzhong 09 on September 24; it is the second model co-developed with XPeng within 24 months. The over five-meter car will offer rear- and all-wheel-drive versions with CATL LFP batteries and VLA-based driver assistance.
items.why_zh: 这是大众与小鹏技术合作落地的又一款量产车，检验外资车企借力中国智驾方案的成效。
items.why_en: Another production result of the Volkswagen-XPeng tie-up, it tests whether foreign automakers can benefit from Chinese smart-driving technology.

items.title_zh: 亚马逊 AWS 旗下 Bedrock 官宣接入 Kimi K3 模型
items.title_en: AWS Bedrock Officially Adds Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 Model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，亚马逊云服务（AWS）旗下人工智能服务平台 Amazon Bedrock 近日宣布接入 Kimi K3 模型，为编程工作提供新选择。 IT之家了解到，Kimi K3 是月之暗面开发的大模型。官方宣称其是首个参数规模达 2.8 万亿的开源模型。该模型原生支持视觉能力，拥有 100 万 Token 的上下文窗口，非常适合执行长时间编程、多文档分析等工作。 Amazon Bedrock 将为 Kimi K3 提供闭源模型相同的安全边界，拥有统一的访问控制、加密和审计机制。Kimi K3 是 Amazon Bedrock 首个支持显式提示缓存的开放权重模型。当多次调用模型时重复使用上下文，可借此降低延迟和输入成本。
items.summary_en: Amazon Bedrock has integrated Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, which the company calls the first open-source model with 2.8 trillion parameters, native vision and a 1M-token context window. It is Bedrock's first open-weight model with explicit prompt caching.
items.why_zh: 中国开源大模型进入 AWS 主力平台并首次获得显式提示缓存支持，直接影响开发者的成本与模型选择。
items.why_en: A Chinese open-weight model entering AWS's core platform with prompt caching directly affects developer cost and model choice.

items.title_zh: 智谱上线“数据内容不留存”，开发者仍在等三个答案
items.title_en: Zhipu AI Rolls Out 'No Data Retention' Option as Developers Await Answers
items.summary_zh: 智谱上线“数据内容不留存”，开发者仍在等三个答案 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Zhipu AI has launched a 'no data retention' option, addressing privacy and compliance concerns around model calls. However, developers say three key questions remain unanswered, with the exact scope and implementation details still unclear.
items.why_zh: 数据留存政策直接决定企业能否把大模型用于敏感场景，官方解释缺位会延缓落地。
items.why_en: Data-retention rules determine whether enterprises can use the model for sensitive workloads, so missing details can slow adoption.

items.title_zh: 亚马逊官宣接入Kimi K3 ，月之暗面IPO吸引多家美国基金
items.title_en: Amazon Adds Kimi K3; Moonshot AI's IPO Draws Multiple US Funds
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊官宣接入Kimi K3 ，月之暗面IPO吸引多家美国基金 t.cj.sina.cn
items.summary_en: Amazon has announced support for Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 on its platform, while reports say the company's IPO has drawn interest from several US funds, pointing to progress on both distribution and capital fronts.
items.why_zh: 产品接入国际云平台与 IPO 引资同步推进，是月之暗面国际化与资本化的关键信号。
items.why_en: Simultaneous cloud distribution and IPO fundraising mark key steps in Moonshot AI's global and capital-market ambitions.

items.title_zh: 美国数据中心建设遭遇民间抵制，二季度 680 亿美元项目受阻
items.title_en: US data center boom hits grassroots resistance as $68B in projects stall in Q2
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，据彭博社报道，美国国内反对建设数据中心的声浪持续高涨。 研究机构数据中心观察（Data Center Watch）发布的信息显示，今年 4‑6 月，受地方民众抵制影响，美国大约有 45 个、总投资额 680 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 4,559.2 亿元人民币） 的数据中心项目遭到搁置或是延期。 如今美国各地社区纷纷推动出台新建项目的暂缓禁令，很多时候相关行动甚至发生在开发商提交建设许可申请之前。该机构周一向彭博新闻社提供的一份报告指出，已有大约 30 个州的州议会提出或者正式通过相关法规，对数据中心选址、用电、耗水等问题作出约束。 这份研究用具体数字反映出社会各界对于人工智能急速扩张的忧虑 —— 既包括大规模新建算力集群，也包括 AI 不断渗透普通人日常生活所带来的隐患。目前，除夏威夷州以外，美国其余 49 个州一共成立了 843 个民间反对团体。 首席分析师米克尔 · 比拉（Miquel Vila）表示：“新的民间反对组织仍在不断成立，抵制活动已经蔓延到众多州与辖区，线上请愿的签名数量也还在持续上涨。”数据中心观察（Data Center Watch）是 AI 情报企业 10a Labs 旗下的项目。 美国聚集着规模最大的一批 AI 基础设施投资方，当下针对数据中心的民间反对已经形成跨党派的舆论反弹。批评者认为这类设施破坏环境、消耗大量资…
items.summary_en: A report by research firm Data Center Watch says about 45 US data center projects worth $68 billion were stalled or delayed in April–June amid local opposition, while roughly 30 state legislatures are weighing or have passed rules on siting, power and water use. Some 843 grassroots opposition groups have formed across 49 states, reflecting mounting public concern over AI's rapid buildout.
items.why_zh: 民间抵制正从个案演变为跨党派的政策阻力，直接抬高 AI 算力基础设施的落地成本与不确定性。
items.why_en: Grassroots resistance is turning into cross-partisan policy friction, raising the cost and uncertainty of building out AI compute infrastructure in the US.

items.title_zh: 掌阅推出 iReader Air 3 Pro“泊渊”电纸书：8.2 英寸 Carta 1300 墨水屏、增加阅读灯，2799 元
items.title_en: iReader Air 3 Pro 'Boyuan' e-reader launches with 8.2-inch e-ink screen and front light for 2,799 yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，掌阅在今年 8 月发布了 Air 3 Pro 电纸书阅读器，采用无前光设计。掌阅现已推出 iReader Air 3 Pro“泊渊”电纸书，增加阅读灯， 售价 2799 元 。 屏幕方面，新品搭载 8.2 英寸 Carta 1300 墨水屏 ，采用 云曦柔光屏 ，支持 30 级亮度和 30 级色温调节；分辨率 1920*1440、293 PPI；具备 256 灰阶 3.0 技术，黑白灰过渡更顺滑。 iReader Air 3 Pro 泊渊采用一体 CNC 金属中框，机身厚度约 5.4mm，重量约 270g；配备双智能物理按键，支持全自定义，可设置返回上一页、下一页、截图、返回主页等功能，底部增加虚拟返回键和 AI 快捷键。 性能方面，这款电纸书搭载 6 纳米工艺 8 核 CPU + 独立 GPU（具体型号未公布），4GB + 64GB 组合，支持 TF / microSD 卡拓展，最高可拓展 2TB 存储空间；电池 2600mAh，官方数据支持 65 小时阅读、 18 天待机。 系统方面，新品搭载 SmartOS 4.0 系统，可一键拉取第三方应用优化参数，也可分享自定义参数；深度优化 PDF 阅读体验，支持 PDF 重排、去水印、排版切换等功能。 IT之家附这款新品详细参数如下： 京东 掌阅 Air 3 Pro 泊渊 8.2 英寸电子书阅读器 27…
items.summary_en: iReader has launched the Air 3 Pro 'Boyuan' e-reader at 2,799 yuan, adding a front light to the August model. It packs an 8.2-inch Carta 1300 e-ink display (1920×1440, 293 PPI, 30-level brightness and color temperature), a 5.4mm CNC metal body, a 6nm octa-core CPU, 4GB+64GB storage with 2TB microSD expansion and a 2,600mAh battery rated for 65 hours of reading.
items.why_zh: 在黑白色与彩色、快刷电纸书竞争加剧之际，掌阅用“加阅读灯、保留高对比无前光方案”的细分策略补齐产品线。
items.why_en: As e-ink competition intensifies, iReader is filling out its lineup by adding a front light while keeping its high-contrast, no-front-light option.

items.title_zh: vivo X500 Pro 系列全新配色「大地回声」公布，带细闪星光
items.title_en: vivo reveals 'Earth Echo' colorway for X500 Pro series with subtle starlight shimmer
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，vivo 官方今日公布 X500 Pro 手机全新配色「大地回声」，新机将于今晚 19:00 正式发布。 从官方发布的图片我们可以看到，「大地回声」整体是灰色配色，摄像头模组与后盖下半部分的灰有所不同，底部还可呈现出细闪星光。 据IT之家此前报道 ，vivo X500 Pro 系列手机将搭载天玑 9600 Pro 旗舰芯片。Pro Max 机型全球首发京东方 Q11 2K 蔡司大师色彩屏，这是一块 6.85 英寸 2K 的 Pro Max 大屏。 新机搭载蔡司 2 亿 APO 超级长焦，传感器为 X300 Ultra 同款，1/1.4" 蓝图 × 三星 HP0。全球首发蓝图光御 900 传感器，还首发主摄和潜望长焦 CIPA 7.0 防抖等级，带来了全新升级的 AI 摄影助手。
items.summary_en: vivo has unveiled 'Earth Echo,' a gray colorway for its X500 Pro series featuring a subtle starlight shimmer at the bottom, ahead of a 19:00 launch event. The lineup is expected to run on the Dimensity 9600 Pro, with the Pro Max debuting a 6.85-inch BOE Q11 2K ZEISS display and a 200MP ZEISS APO telephoto, plus first-run sensors, CIPA 7.0 stabilization and an upgraded AI photo assistant.
items.why_zh: 新配色与首发传感器、CIPA 7.0 防抖一同，构成 vivo 在高端影像旗舰上的差异化卖点。
items.why_en: The new colorway, alongside first-run sensors and CIPA 7.0 stabilization, sharpens vivo's differentiation in the premium camera-phone segment.

items.title_zh: 智谱回应代码数据争议，目前相关机制已修复，将ZCode开源交给社区监督
items.title_en: Zhipu responds to code-data controversy, says fix is in place and will open-source ZCode for community oversight
items.summary_zh: 智谱回应代码数据争议，目前相关机制已修复，将ZCode开源交给社区监督 证券时报
items.summary_en: Zhipu has responded to the controversy over code data related to ZCode, saying the relevant mechanism has been fixed and that it will open-source ZCode for community oversight. The company has also said its MaaS platform will offer a no-data-retention option, in a bid to address privacy and data-use concerns.
items.why_zh: 代码与训练数据来源的合规争议，正成为中国大模型厂商的信任考验，开源加数据不留存是典型的危机应对组合。
items.why_en: Compliance questions over code and training data are becoming a trust test for Chinese LLM makers, making open-sourcing plus no-retention policies a typical crisis response.

items.title_zh: 小米 18 Pro 系列手机全新智能防窥屏亮点公布，支持应用自定义、规则设定等
items.title_en: Xiaomi 18 Pro series to feature smart privacy screen with per-app rules
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，小米手机今日宣布， 小米 18 Pro 系列的超级像素屏幕迈入 2.0 时代 ，同时拥有“旗舰画质与原生硬件级防窥”。小米官方宣称，这是面向未来的全新屏幕解决方案。 IT之家注意到，小米手机官方刚刚发布视频，介绍了小米 18 Pro 系列手机全新智能防窥屏的核心亮点： 支持防窥应用自定义，防窥区域灵动百变 更支持个性化防窥规则设定 在哪里怎么防，一句话交给超级小爱 从官方介绍视频来看，小米 18 Pro 系列手机的防窥屏支持自定义 App 通知防窥、自定义 App 小窗防窥、自定义 App 分屏防窥、自定义 App 锁屏通知防窥、自定义 AI 键一键开启全局防窥、小爱同学设定规则进行防窥。 根据规划，小米 18 Pro 系列手机将在 9 月 23 日 19:00 发布。小米集团合伙人 / 总裁、手机部总裁、小米品牌总经理卢伟冰透露， 新机会涨价，但相信大家会觉得合理 。 系列新机已官宣搭载 2nm 旗舰移动平台、徕卡双 2 亿超清影像系统、新一代超级像素屏幕（全新 M11 发光体系）、0.99mm 极窄边屏幕设计、32% 超高硅小米金沙江电池。
items.summary_en: Xiaomi says the 18 Pro series' Super Pixel display 2.0 combines flagship image quality with hardware-level privacy. Its smart anti-peeping screen supports per-app customization and rule settings covering notifications, floating windows, split screen and lock-screen notices, plus an AI button for one-tap global privacy. The phones launch on September 23.
items.why_zh: 把防窥从贴膜或软件方案升级为屏幕硬件级能力，并交由 AI 语音配置，显示隐私功能正成为高端手机的新卖点。
items.why_en: Turning privacy protection into a hardware-level display feature configured by AI voice shows privacy is becoming a premium-phone selling point.

items.title_zh: 智谱回应ZCode隐私争议：开源、审计、数据不留存“三箭齐发”
items.title_en: Zhipu answers ZCode privacy row with open source, audits and no data retention
items.summary_zh: 智谱回应ZCode隐私争议：开源、审计、数据不留存“三箭齐发” 东方财富
items.summary_en: Zhipu is responding to the ZCode privacy controversy with a three-part plan: open-sourcing ZCode, enabling audits and committing to no data retention. The company has also said its MaaS platform will gain a no-retention option, aiming to rebuild trust through transparency.
items.why_zh: 对以开发者为主要用户的代码类产品而言，隐私与数据留存策略直接决定其能否被企业放心采用。
items.why_en: For developer-facing coding tools, privacy and retention policies directly determine whether enterprises will adopt them with confidence.

items.title_zh: 智谱在ZCode事件后宣布MaaS平台上线数据不留存功能
items.title_en: After ZCode backlash, Zhipu adds no-data-retention option to its MaaS platform
items.summary_zh: 智谱在ZCode事件后宣布MaaS平台上线数据不留存功能 虎嗅
items.summary_en: Following the ZCode incident, Zhipu says its MaaS platform will introduce a no-data-retention feature, a direct answer to concerns about how user data is stored and used. The company has also said the mechanism at issue was fixed and that ZCode will be open-sourced for community oversight.
items.why_zh: 数据不留存正成为大模型平台争取企业客户的基础合规能力，而非可有可无的加分项。
items.why_en: No-data-retention is becoming a baseline compliance requirement, rather than a bonus, for LLM platforms courting enterprise customers.

items.title_zh: 智谱开源ZCode，MaaS拟上线数据内容不留存
items.title_en: Zhipu open-sources ZCode, plans no-data-content-retention for MaaS
items.summary_zh: 智谱开源ZCode，MaaS拟上线数据内容不留存 动点科技
items.summary_en: Zhipu says it will open-source ZCode and plans to add a no-data-content-retention option to its MaaS platform, moves that follow the recent ZCode controversy. The company previously said the mechanism at issue had been fixed and would place ZCode under community oversight.
items.why_zh: 开源代码加上取消数据留存，是大模型厂商在信任受损后重建开发者信心的典型路径。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing code and dropping data retention is a typical path for LLM vendors seeking to rebuild developer trust after a credibility hit.

items.title_zh: 从“偷传代码”到开源整改，智谱风波折射AI企业数据合规之困
items.title_en: From 'Secret Code Transfers' to Open-Source Rectification: Zhipu Controversy Exposes AI Data Compliance Woes
items.summary_zh: 从“偷传代码”到开源整改，智谱风波折射AI企业数据合规之困 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Chinese AI company Zhipu has moved from a controversy over allegedly secretly transferring code to an open-source rectification effort, a case reports frame as emblematic of AI firms' data-compliance difficulties. The episode highlights how surging data needs in model training and product development collide with unclear sourcing, usage boundaries and internal governance. It also raises the question of whether open-source fixes can truly resolve compliance risks.
items.why_zh: 数据合规正成为中国大模型公司必须跨过的现实门槛，这一风波是行业普遍问题的典型案例。
items.why_en: Data compliance is becoming a make-or-break issue for Chinese LLM companies, and this episode illustrates a problem the whole industry faces.

items.title_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode即将正式开源，并开展安全审计
items.title_en: Zhipu Responds to Data Privacy Controversy: ZCode to Be Officially Open-Sourced with Security Audit
items.summary_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode即将正式开源，并开展安全审计 泰伯网
items.summary_en: Zhipu has responded to the recent data privacy controversy surrounding ZCode, saying that ZCode will soon be officially open-sourced and that a security audit will be conducted. The move is seen as an effort to increase transparency and ease concerns over data privacy. Details of the controversy, the open-source timeline, and the audit party have not yet been disclosed.
items.why_zh: AI数据隐私争议关乎用户信任与行业合规，开源和安全审计是重建可信度的关键步骤。
items.why_en: AI data privacy disputes affect user trust and industry compliance, making open-sourcing and security audits key steps to rebuild credibility.

items.title_zh: 阶跃Step 5 Preview 升至全球开源前二|Kimi K3|阶跃星辰|模型评测|大模型|开源模型_手机新浪网
items.title_en: StepFun's Step 5 Preview Rises to Second Among Global Open-Source Models
items.summary_zh: 阶跃Step 5 Preview 升至全球开源前二|Kimi K3|阶跃星辰|模型评测|大模型|开源模型_手机新浪网 新浪财经
items.summary_en: According to a Sina Finance report, StepFun's Step 5 Preview has climbed to second place among global open-source models in a model evaluation, with Kimi K3 also mentioned. The report did not disclose the specific benchmark, scores or comparison data.
items.why_zh: 开源大模型榜单排名变动，反映国产模型在开源赛道上的竞争加剧。
items.why_en: Shifting rankings on open-source model leaderboards highlight intensifying competition among Chinese open-source models.

items.title_zh: 微软 AI 负责人苏莱曼：美国不应该以中国 AI 发展太快为理由反对监管
items.title_en: Microsoft AI Chief Suleyman: US Should Not Oppose AI Regulation Because China Is Moving Fast
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，微软 AI 负责人穆斯塔法 · 苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman ）在 CNN 的 Fareed Zakaria GPS 节目中表示， 对中国 AI 进展的担忧不应成为反对设置 AI 防护措施的理由 。 IT之家注意到，他的言论与美国总统特朗普的观点形成鲜明对比，后者呼吁 AI 应大体不受限制地发展，并称对失控 AI 可能带来灾难性后果的担忧是骗局。 苏莱曼领导的微软 AI 团队在上周二发布了一份宣言，为其自身的 AI 开发提供指导， 目标是让人类始终掌控公司未来开发的 AI 系统 。 苏莱曼告诉 CNN，AI 开发者应给模型设定目标，这些目标要“受人文主义准则的约束”。“我认为每个开发者都应该为 AI 设定限制目标，即应有明确的防护措施。” 他说，监管不应被视为“坏事”，而应被视为“创建共同规范和标准以提高安全性”。“这不一定会拖慢我们的速度。”
items.summary_en: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman told CNN's Fareed Zakaria GPS that concerns about China's AI progress should not be used as an argument against AI safeguards, putting him at odds with President Trump's push for largely unfettered development. His team released a manifesto last Tuesday aimed at keeping humans in control of the AI systems Microsoft builds. Suleyman said every developer should set humanist-constrained goals and explicit guardrails, adding that regulation is not inherently bad and need not slow progress.
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 安全与监管之争中的一次高调表态，直接对冲了“因竞争而放松监管”的主流政治论调。
items.why_en: It is a high-profile intervention in the AI safety-versus-speed debate, directly pushing back on the argument that competition justifies lighter regulation.

items.title_zh: 智谱致歉：已将ZCode开源
items.title_en: Zhipu Apologizes: ZCode Has Been Open-Sourced

The company had earlier responded to data privacy concerns by saying it would officially open-source ZCode and conduct a security audit. The apology and open-source release signal a more transparent approach, though details of the dispute and audit plans remain undisclosed.
items.why_zh: 从争议到致歉并开源，这一事件凸显AI公司面对数据隐私质疑时，透明与开源正成为重建信任的必要手段。
items.why_en: From controversy to apology and open-sourcing, this case highlights that transparency and open source are becoming essential for AI companies to rebuild trust amid data privacy concerns.

items.title_zh: 价值几何：用任务向量组合实现语言模型的伦理偏好对齐
items.title_en: Geometry of Values: Task Vector Composition for Ethical Preference Alignment in Language Models
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大模型在价值冲突场景下的行为：即便强模型也存在隐藏偏见，且跨语言指令遵循不够稳健。作者构建了一个包含 1.2 万条二选一困境实例的数据集，覆盖三组两两价值冲突——诚实与公正、公正与自主、自主与诚实，并将数据翻译为印地语、阿拉伯语、西班牙语和中文，用于探测跨语言表现。在 GPT-5-mini 上的基准测试显示，模型会一致性地偏向某一方价值（摘要在此处截断），作者据此提出用任务向量组合的方式做伦理偏好对齐。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21094v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications that must weigh clashing moral values, yet even strong models exhibit hidden biases and brittle instruction-following across languages. We introduce a 12,000-instance dataset of two-option dilemmas covering pairwise three value conflicts: Honesty vs. Justice, Justice vs. Autonomy, and Autonomy vs. Honesty, along with their translations into Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, and Chinese, to probe cross-lingual behavior. Benchmarking on GPT-5-mini reveals that it consistently favors Hon…
items.why_zh: 把价值对齐从抽象原则变成可测量、可跨语言检验的工程问题，是伦理对齐研究向前推进的一步。
items.why_en: It turns value alignment from abstract principle into a measurable, cross-lingual engineering problem.

items.title_zh: Samsone：面向端侧推理的开源小型音频语言模型系列
items.title_en: Samsone: A Family of Open Small Audio Language Models for On-Device Inference
items.summary_zh: 大型音频语言模型的成功推动了参数量达数十亿的多模态网络发展，但隐私保护与低延迟处理的需求，正把关注点转向可在设备端运行的小型音频语言模型（SALM）。论文提出 Samsone 系列，专为边缘计算设计，核心模型 Samsone-134M 在多个基准上刷新了同规模模型的最佳表现。作者还通过该系列进一步探讨小型音频语言模型的缩放规律。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21666v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The success of Large Audio Language Models has driven the development of massive multimodal networks exceeding billions of parameters. However, the demand for privacy-preserving, low-latency processing has shifted focus toward Small Audio Language Models (SALMs) capable of on-device execution. In this paper, we introduce Samsone, a family of SALMs designed for edge computing. Our core model, Samsone-134M, establishes a new state-of-the-art for its size class across multiple benchmarks. We further explore the scaling laws of SALMs by introducing…
items.why_zh: 端侧小型音频模型兼顾隐私与延迟，是语音交互走向本地化部署的关键方向。
items.why_en: On-device small audio models combine privacy and low latency, a key path toward localizing voice interaction.

items.title_zh: 从代码归档到知识图谱：打通 Software Heritage、COAR Notify 与 Wikidata
items.title_en: From Code Archival to Knowledge Graph: Bridging Software Heritage, COAR Notify and Wikidata
items.summary_zh: 软件已是科学研究中的一等对象，但源代码与学术记录之间经过验证的关联，大多仍缺席于开放关联数据（LOD）云，使归档的软件产物难以被语义发现。论文提出了一套端到端的对账流水线，从论文与源代码之间关系明确且经编辑核验的来源中采集、验证并建模“论文—代码仓库”配对，这些来源包括以软件为核心的期刊 JOSS、SoftwareX、IPOL，以及可复现性报告等。该工作旨在把软件归档接入知识图谱，让代码与学术记录能够被关联检索与复用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21667v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Software is a first-class scientific object, yet validated links between source code and the scholarly record remain largely absent from the Linked Open Data (LOD) cloud, isolating archived artefacts from semantic discovery. This paper presents an end-to-end reconciliation pipeline that harvests, validates, and models publication-to-repository pairs from sources where the link between a paper and its source code is explicit and editorially verified: the software-centric journals JOSS, SoftwareX, and IPOL, together with the reproducibility repor…
items.why_zh: 让代码与论文在开放知识图谱中真正可关联，是提升科研可复现性与软件可发现性的基础设施工作。
items.why_en: Linking code and papers in open knowledge graphs is infrastructure work that improves reproducibility and software discoverability.

items.title_zh: Bad Genius：用反事实引导的评测框架演化超越任务特定捷径
items.title_en: Bad Genius: Counterfactual-Guided Harness Evolution Beyond Task-Specific Shortcuts
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，自动化的评测框架（harness）优化会干扰智能体评估的可靠性：一个 Proposer 反复利用已发布的基准 B_rel，去修改固定目标智能体周边的提示、记忆、检索、工具和控制代码。由于任务留出只改变语义任务而基准协议保持固定，一个“坏天才”式的 Proposer 就能造出作弊框架，其在已发布基准上的增益依赖于某个贯穿整个基准的捷径。为此作者提出反事实框架搜索与演化（CHASE），把框架演化重新表述为反事实引导的过程，以摆脱任务特定捷径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.18366v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable agent evaluation is complicated by automatic harness optimization, which repeatedly uses a released benchmark $B_{\mathrm{rel}}$ to guide a Proposer that edits prompts, memory, retrieval, tools, and control code around a fixed target agent. Task holdout varies semantic tasks but leaves the benchmark protocol fixed, so a "bad genius" Proposer can produce a cheating harness whose released-benchmark gain depends on a benchmark-wide shortcut. We introduce Counterfactual Harness Search and Evolution (CHASE), which casts harness evolution…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了基准分数可能被“优化框架”而非真实能力抬高的风险，直指当前智能体评测的可信度问题。
items.why_en: It exposes how benchmark scores can be inflated by harness optimization rather than real capability, hitting at the credibility of current agent evaluations.

items.title_zh: 固定规划器下的技能模块演化：长周期机器人系统的版本化、回滚与运行时治理
items.title_en: Evolving Skill Modules under a Fixed Planner: Versioning, Rollback, and Runtime Governance for Long-Lived Robot Systems
items.summary_zh: 论文把长期部署机器人的技能升级当作软件生命周期问题来处理：固定的决策层负责分发带版本的技能模块，另建运行时层对每个动作进行筛查。作者在六个 robosuite 任务上报告了三项负面结果和两项测量：其一，峰值任务成功率在不同随机种子间并不稳定，同一方法内部可从 23.3% 波动到 73.3%，因此单次运行的峰值不能用来给这些方法排名；其二，系统中的四个模块都是整体任务策略。研究由此强调版本化、回滚与运行时治理对长期运行机器人系统的必要性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.07799v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Robots deployed for long periods keep improving their skills, and each update changes a released system. We treat this as a software-lifecycle problem: a fixed decision layer dispatches versioned skill modules and a runtime layer was built to screen each action. On six robosuite tasks we report three negative results and two measurements. First, peak task success is unstable across random seeds (within one method it spans 23.3 to 73.3%), so single-run peaks cannot rank these methods. Second, the system's four modules are whole-task poli…
items.why_zh: 它用负面结果提醒研究界：长期运行机器人的评测与更新治理，比单次峰值成绩更值得关注。
items.why_en: Its negative results warn that governance and evaluation of continually updated robots matter more than single-run peak scores.

items.title_zh: 从瞬时情绪推断到持续情绪支持：一项陪伴智能体的纵向研究评估
items.title_en: From Momentary Emotion Inference to Sustained Emotion Support: Evaluating a Companion Agent in a Longitudinal Study
items.summary_zh: 持续的情绪支持是一种与人类福祉密切相关的长周期交互任务，此前研究已证明生成式智能体具备瞬时情绪支持能力，但这种能力能否随时间延续仍不清楚。为此作者部署了基于情绪调节理论的陪伴智能体 PAIR，邀请 19 名参与者连续使用 14 天，共记录 1,093 次会话。研究将情绪估计与指导前后的自我报告配对，并结合日志与访谈进行分析，发现情绪估计与自我报告的吻合度更高（摘要在此处截断），从而评估陪伴智能体在长期使用中的真实支持效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16344v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sustained emotional support is a long-horizon interaction task closely tied to human well-being. Recent research demonstrates generative agents' capacity for momentary emotional support, yet how these capabilities sustain support over time remains unclear. To examine this challenge, we deployed PAIR, a theory-based emotion-regulation companion, with 19 participants for 14 days. Across 1,093 sessions, we paired emotion estimates with self-reports before and after guidance and analyzed logs and interviews. Estimates corresponded more clos…
items.why_zh: 它把陪伴智能体从短时情绪识别推进到长期真实使用评估，为情绪支持类 AI 的效果与风险提供了实证依据。
items.why_en: It moves companion agents from momentary emotion recognition to real longitudinal evaluation, providing evidence on the effectiveness and risks of emotional-support AI.

items.title_zh: 多受试者预训练实现闭集表面肌电语音解码的短校准个性化
items.title_en: Multi-Subject Pretraining Enables Short-Calibration Personalization for Closed-Corpus Surface EMG Speech Decoding
items.summary_zh: 该研究针对基于表面肌电（sEMG）的无声语音接口，聚焦跨用户差异与校准负担这一核心痛点。实验中 27 名受试者每人仅提供不足 0.5 小时数据（平均 21.3 分钟），涵盖出声与默读两种说话方式，并在闭集 50 句语料上采用留一受试者交叉验证。方法上，作者以已公开的单受试者检查点为初始化，先在未留出受试者数据上做多受试者预训练，再对目标受试者微调。该流程在该有限数据设定下取得 21.7% 的字符级解码结果，表明多受试者预训练可显著降低个性化校准成本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21288v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG)-based silent speech interfaces are limited by cross-user variability and calibration burden. We study a limited-data setting in which each of 27 speech-typical participants contributed less than 0.5 h of data (21.3 min on average) across Aloud and Mimed speech. Within a closed 50-sentence corpus, we used leave-one-subject-out evaluation, initializing from a released single-subject checkpoint, pretraining on non-held-out participants, and fine-tuning on the target participant. This pipeline achieved 21.7% character…
items.why_zh: 它证明多受试者预训练能大幅缓解肌电语音接口的个性化校准负担，为低数据下的实用化铺路。
items.why_en: It shows multi-subject pretraining can sharply reduce calibration burden, a key barrier to practical sEMG speech interfaces.

items.title_zh: 超越运动学：面向肌肉驱动模仿学习的仿真保真度基准测试
items.title_en: Beyond Kinematics: Benchmarking Simulation Fidelity for Muscle-Driven Imitation Learning
items.summary_zh: 该工作系统比较了两套当前最先进的运动模仿强化学习（MIRL）流水线：一套基于 SCONE/HyFyDy，另一套基于 MuJoCo/MyoSim。HyFyDy 通过细致的肌腱建模强调生理真实性，而 MuJoCo 更侧重计算效率与可扩展的策略学习。尽管已有研究显示两条流水线都能高保真复现人体运动学，但它们是否能准确捕捉产生这些动作的底层神经肌肉行为仍不清楚。论文据此对仿真保真度展开基准测试，指出仅以运动学匹配衡量仿真质量存在局限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we conduct a systematic comparison of two state-of-the-art motion-imitation reinforcement learning (MIRL) pipelines, one built on SCONE/HyFyDy and one built on MuJoCo/MyoSim. HyFyDy emphasizes physiological realism through detailed musculotendon modeling, while MuJoCo prioritizes computational efficiency and scalable policy learning. While recent work has demonstrated that both pipelines reproduce human kinematics with high fidelity, it remains unclear if they accurately capture the underlying neuromuscular behavior that produced th…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究者：运动学吻合并不等于神经肌肉行为正确，为肌肉驱动仿真与模仿学习设立更可靠的评估标准。
items.why_en: It warns that kinematic match does not guarantee correct neuromuscular behavior, pushing for better fidelity standards in muscle-driven imitation learning.

items.title_zh: 学会迁移城市：城市网络校准与控制的深度元模型与强化学习策略
items.title_en: Learning to Move Cities: Deep Meta-Models and Reinforcement Policies for Calibration and Control in Urban Networks
items.summary_zh: 城市交通网络同时面临高保真仿真器校准与实时运行控制两大复杂优化难题。论文提出一个共享潜空间框架，通过统一的、可学习的城市交通动态表征，把仿真器校准与强化学习控制连接起来。作者首先构建组合式 MLP 自编码器架构，学习将仿真器输入（起讫需求、网络参数）映射到输出（行程时间、拥堵状况等）的低维流形。该共享表征使校准与控制能够相互支撑，从而在同一框架内提升仿真精度与实时决策能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21945v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Urban transportation networks present complex optimization challenges spanning calibration of high-fidelity simulators and real-time operational control. This paper presents a shared latent-space framework that connects simulator calibration and reinforcement learning control through a common learned representation of urban traffic dynamics. First, we develop a combinatorial MLP-autoencoder architecture that learns low-dimensional manifolds linking simulator inputs (origin-destination demand, network parameters) to outputs (travel times, congesti…
items.why_zh: 它把仿真校准与实时控制统一到共享潜空间，为城市交通这类高维复杂系统提供了可复用的建模范式。
items.why_en: Unifying calibration and real-time control in one latent space offers a reusable paradigm for complex urban traffic systems.

items.title_zh: 面向个性化液体复苏的自适应不确定性感知建模与随机径向基函数预测控制
items.title_en: Adaptive Uncertainty-Aware Modeling and Stochastic Radial Basis Function Predictive Control for Personalized Fluid Resuscitation
items.summary_zh: 论文提出一个将贝叶斯生理建模与最优控制相结合的框架，用于液体复苏过程中具备不确定性感知的个体化血流动力学调控。作者先构建不确定性感知变分自编码器状态空间模型（UVAE-SSM），在数据有限的情况下刻画平均动脉压（MAP）与输液量之间的动态关系，并显式建模测量噪声等偶然不确定性。随后引入贝叶斯非线性模型与随机径向基函数预测控制，使治疗方案能随不确定性动态调整，从而提升个性化复苏的安全性与效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper presents a novel framework integrating Bayesian physiological modeling with optimal control strategies to achieve uncertainty-aware, personalized hemodynamic regulation during fluid resuscitation. An uncertainty-aware variational autoencoder state-space model (UVAE-SSM) was first developed to capture the dynamical relationship between mean arterial pressure (MAP) and fluid infusion using limited data, while explicitly modeling aleatoric uncertainty (i.e., randomness in the measurements, such as sensor noise). Then, a Bayesian nonline…
items.why_zh: 它把不确定性显式纳入临床决策闭环，推动重症液体复苏从经验方案走向可量化、可自适应的个体化治疗。
items.why_en: By embedding uncertainty into the clinical control loop, it moves fluid resuscitation toward quantifiable, adaptive personalized therapy.

items.title_zh: 语义校准胜于词元置信度：长文本科学问答的不确定性量化基准
items.title_en: Semantic Calibration Prevails Where Token Confidence Fails: Benchmarking Long-Form Scientific QA
items.summary_zh: 论文关注大语言模型在科学问答中的可靠不确定性量化（UQ），因为长篇输出已超出人工逐条核查的可行规模。作者提出了首个面向长文本、强推理科学问答的 UQ 校准大规模基准，在最多 20 个 LLM、七个数据集上评估了四种 UQ 方法，共覆盖 685,000 条回答。配套的开源框架采用共享生成设计，保证跨方法比较可复现。结果显示，在词元级置信度失效之处，语义层面的校准更为有效。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.00279v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for safe deployment of large language models (LLMs) in scientific question answering, where long-form outputs exceed practical human verification at scale. We introduce the first large-scale benchmark for UQ calibration in long-form, reasoning-demanding scientific QA, evaluating four UQ methods on 685,000 responses across up to 20 LLMs and seven datasets, supported by an extensible open-source framework whose shared-generation design enables reproducible cross-method comparisons. Ins…
items.why_zh: 它为长文本科学问答中的可靠性评估提供了可比基准，并指出词元置信度不可靠、语义校准更值得信赖。
items.why_en: It provides a comparable benchmark for reliability in long-form scientific QA and shows token confidence is less trustworthy than semantic calibration.

items.title_zh: 免疫治疗反应预测的转录组模型跨队列泛化能力有限

items.summary_zh: 免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）改变了癌症治疗格局，但相当比例患者存在原发或获得性耐药，因此治疗前的准确反应预测仍是关键未满足需求。基于批量与单细胞 RNA 测序的转录组生物标志物有望刻画肿瘤—免疫相互作用，然而现有预测模型的跨队列泛化能力仍不明确。作者系统基准测试了九种最先进的转录组 ICI 反应预测模型，结果表明这些模型在不同队列间泛化能力有限，提示其临床推广仍需谨慎验证。

Transcriptomics-based biomarkers derived from bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) offer a promising avenue for capturing tumour-immune interactions, yet the cross-cohort generalisability of existing prediction models remains unclear.We systematically benchmark nine state-of-the-art transcriptomic ICI respo…
items.why_zh: 它揭示当前转录组免疫治疗预测模型跨队列表现不佳，提醒临床转化前必须做严格的外部验证。
items.why_en: It reveals weak cross-cohort performance of transcriptomic ICI prediction models, underscoring the need for external validation before clinical use.

Industry applications such as government, manufacturing and public utilities generated over two-thirds of revenue from under 40% of shipments, growing 125.1% in value and 260.5% in deployments. Unitree, DEEP Robotics and AgiBot led the vendor rankings.

items.why_en: The data shows quadrupeds shifting from research demos to industrial deployment, with industry applications driving both growth and revenue.

items.title_en: vivo X500 Pro Max Debuts BOE Q11 Emissive Material 2K Zeiss Master Color Display
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，vivo X500 Pro Max 手机将全球首发 Q11 发光材料 2K 蔡司大师色彩屏。京东方 BOE 表示， 这是其迄今最新、水准最高的 Q11 发光材料 。 据京东方介绍，新机屏幕尺寸达到 6.85 英寸，可实现整机功耗降低 21%、使用寿命提升 100%，并拥有电影级全链路色彩显示、超感光自动亮度等“黑科技”。此外，通过集成京东方 LTPO 自适应刷新技术， 可实现 1-144Hz 不同使用场景的自适应刷新频率 。 根据规划，vivo X500 系列手机将于 9 月 21 日发布。参考IT之家此前报道，新机将搭载蔡司 2 亿 APO 超级长焦，传感器为 Ultra 同款 1/1.4" 蓝图 × 三星 HP0。 全球首发蓝图光御 900 传感器 ，还首发主摄和潜望长焦 CIPA 7.0 防抖等级，带来了全新升级的 AI 摄影助手。 除了常规配置外，vivo X500 Pro Max 还适配增距镜、专业影像手柄套装。关于 vivo X500 Pro Max 手机的更多消息，感兴趣的朋友可以关注IT之家对发布会的报道。
items.summary_en: vivo's X500 Pro Max will be the first phone to feature BOE's latest Q11 emissive material on a 2K Zeiss Master Color display. BOE says the 6.85-inch panel cuts device power consumption by 21%, doubles lifespan, and supports 1-144Hz LTPO adaptive refresh.
items.why_zh: 国产面板最新发光材料与旗舰手机首发结合，体现显示供应链在色彩、功耗与寿命上的竞争升级。
items.why_en: A domestic panel maker's newest emissive material debuting in a flagship phone reflects intensifying competition in display quality and efficiency.

items.title_zh: 科技速递：DeepSeek公布节假日计费规则，智谱MaaS上线数据不留存功能
items.title_en: Tech Briefs: DeepSeek Sets Holiday Billing Rules, Zhipu MaaS Adds No-Data-Retention Option
items.summary_zh: 科技速递：DeepSeek公布节假日计费规则，智谱MaaS上线数据不留存功能 t.cj.sina.cn
items.summary_en: DeepSeek published billing rules for holiday periods, while Zhipu added a no-data-retention option to its MaaS platform. The two updates address cost transparency and enterprise data-compliance needs in AI services.
items.why_zh: 定价规则与数据不留存能力，正成为 AI 平台争取企业与开发者用户的竞争要素。
items.why_en: Billing clarity and no-retention options are becoming competitive factors for AI platforms courting enterprise and developer users.

items.title_zh: 智谱 ZCode 官宣开源：已完成整改并向所有用户道歉
items.title_en: Zhipu Open-Sources ZCode After Apologizing to All Users
items.summary_zh: 智谱 ZCode 官宣开源：已完成整改并向所有用户道歉 DoNews
items.summary_en: Zhipu announced that ZCode is now open source and said it has completed remediation, apologizing to all users after the tool was found to silently upload local Git history. The company deleted the related Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket and fixed the issue in v3.14.0.
items.why_zh: 从争议曝光到开源整改，事件成为 AI 编程工具数据合规与用户信任的典型案例。
items.why_en: From exposure to open-source remediation, the case illustrates data-compliance and trust challenges for AI coding tools.

items.title_zh: 路透：软银集团为投资 OpenAI 启动逾 100 亿美元债券发行
items.title_en: Softbank Group launches over $10 billion in bonds for OpenAI investment, term sheet shows By Reuters
items.summary_zh: 据路透援引条款清单消息，软银集团启动规模超过 100 亿美元的债券发行，用于对 OpenAI 的投资。这是软银围绕 OpenAI 的最新一笔大额融资安排，条款清单显示发行规模已跨过百亿美元门槛。该动作进一步表明软银正通过大规模举债为其 AI 投资组合提供资金支持。
items.summary_en: Softbank Group launches over $10 billion in bonds for OpenAI investment, term sheet shows By Reuters Investing.com
items.why_zh: 百亿美元级发债是软银 AI 战略的资金支点，也反映 OpenAI 相关投资的资本密集程度。
items.why_en: A $10 billion-plus bond issuance is the financial backbone of SoftBank's AI strategy and shows how capital-intensive OpenAI-linked investments are.

items.title_zh: Anthropic CEO 曾呼吁放缓AI发展，公司或在IPO前发布新模型
items.title_en: Anthropic, CEO of which called for slowing AI development, may release new model ahead of IPO
items.summary_zh: 据《印度时报》报道，AI 公司 Anthropic 可能在启动 IPO 之前发布一款新模型。值得注意的是，Anthropic 首席执行官此前曾公开呼吁放缓 AI 发展，理由是安全风险。若消息属实，这将是该公司在资本运作与产品节奏上的重要动作。不过报道未透露新模型的具体能力、发布时间及 IPO 细节。
items.summary_en: Anthropic, CEO of which called for slowing AI development, may release new model ahead of IPO The Times of India
items.why_zh: Anthropic 一边呼吁放缓 AI 开发，一边可能在 IPO 前推出新模型，凸显 AI 安全理念与商业竞争之间的张力。
items.why_en: Anthropic's potential pre-IPO model launch highlights the tension between AI safety advocacy and commercial competition.
